This script will relate the DDM parameters for each subject with their ideological variables.

# Libraries

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(data.table)
```

```{r}
base_dir = "C:/Users/Brian Kim/Documents/OneDrive - Drexel University/Documents/classes/cognew/Neuroethics/IndividualDifferenceRiskBenefit/DATA_ANALYSIS"
behavior_path = paste(base_dir, "/data/Cleaned_Pilot/exclusions.2020.10.21.Rdata", sep="")
load(behavior_path)
risk_data = Neuroethics_Judgement

# This will assign a unique index to each different 'subj_idx'
risk_data$idxP <- as.numeric(as.factor(risk_data$user_id))
```

# Import Data

```{r}
load('../data/exclusions.2020.10.21.RData')

# ddm_subj <- read.csv('hddm_outputs/ddm_basic4pm_stats_final.csv', stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

ddm_subj <- read.csv('timeDDM/Chen-2021/Scripts/ModelResults/Neuroethics/20240313STDDMResults.csv', stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# I will not be using this for now because the number of participants is not the same as the original paper

# clean_data <- read.csv("../data/Cleaned_Pilot/clean_data_longV2.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

clean_data <- Neuroethics_Judgement
```

## Clean DDM Data

```{r}
# Load the necessary library
library(data.table)

# Assuming ddm_subj is already a data.table. If not, convert it:
# ddm_subj <- as.data.table(ddm_subj)

# Step 1: Filter out rows ending with ".mu"
ddm_filtered <- ddm_subj %>% filter(!grepl(".mu", X, perl=TRUE)) 

ddm_filtered <- ddm_filtered %>%
  separate(X, into = c("XXX", "YY"), sep = "\\.?p?\\[") %>%
  mutate(YY = sub("\\]", "", YY))

# bias[86]

ddm_filtered <- ddm_filtered %>%
  mutate(XXX_stat = paste(XXX, rep(c("Mean", "Median", "SD"), each = nrow(ddm_filtered)/length(unique(XXX)))))

# Step 1: Pivot the data to wider format, creating new columns for each combination of XXX and statistics
ddm_wide <- ddm_filtered %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = YY, 
              names_from = XXX, 
              values_from = c(Mean, Median, SD),
              names_sep = "_")  # Creates column names like b1_Mean, b1_Median, b1_SD, etc.

# Example: concatenating all user_id values for each idxP
risk_data_concatenated <- risk_data %>%
  group_by(idxP) %>%
  summarise(user_id = toString(unique(user_id)))  # This creates a single string with all user_id values separated by commas

ddm_wide$YY = as.numeric(ddm_wide$YY)

# Join the concatenated user_id values to ddm_long
ddm_combined <- left_join(as.data.frame(ddm_wide), risk_data_concatenated, by = c("YY" = "idxP"))

```

## Extract Demographic Data

```{r}
clean_data_summary <- clean_data %>%
  group_by(user_id) %>%
  summarise(
    condition = first(condition),
    sex = first(sex),
    age = first(age),
    race_ethnicity = first(race_ethnicity),
    education = first(education),
    AttendChurch = first(AttendChurch),
    Religiosity = first(Religiosity),
    Spirituality = first(Spirituality),
    ReligiousActivity = first(ReligiousActivity),
    meditation = first(meditation),
    Political_Party = first(Political_Party),
    republican = first(republican),
    democrat = first(democrat),
    HumanMind = first(HumanMind),
    conservative = first(conservative),
    liberal = first(liberal),
    Extraversion = first(Extraversion),
    Agreeableness = first(Agreeableness),
    Conscientiousness = first(Conscientiousness),
    Neuroticism = first(Neuroticism),
    Openness = first(Openness),
    Harm = first(Harm),
    Fairness = first(Fairness),
    Loyalty = first(Loyalty),
    Athority = first(Athority),
    Sancticy = first(Sancticy),
    PerspectiveTaking = first(PerspectiveTaking),
    Fantasy = first(Fantasy),
    EmpathicConcern = first(EmpathicConcern),
    PersonalDistress = first(PersonalDistress),
    moral.commitment = first(moral.commitment),
    consequentalism = first(consequentialism.score),
    GRIPS = first(GRiPs_Score)
  )

clean_data_summary$politics = clean_data_summary$republican + clean_data_summary$conservative - clean_data_summary$democrat - clean_data_summary$liberal
```

## Extract Religiosity Score

```{r}
library(psych)
religiousMatrix <- data.matrix(clean_data_summary[,c("Religiosity", "Spirituality", "AttendChurch", "ReligiousActivity")]) - 1

#Kaiser-Meyer-Olkin factor adequacy
KMO <- psych::KMO(religiousMatrix)
KMO
KMO$ImCov

#	Bartlett's Test of Sphericity
REdaS::bart_spher(religiousMatrix)

scree <- psych::polychoric(religiousMatrix)$rho
evals <- eigen(scree)$values
print(scree, cutoff = "0.3")
scree(scree, factors = F)

#religiousMatrix <- psych::polychoric(religiousMatrix)
EFA <- fa(religiousMatrix, nfactors = 1, rotate = "oblimin", fm ="ml")
print(EFA$loadings, cutoff = "0.4")
#round(EFA$Phi, 3)
(evals/sum(evals)*100)[1:4]
EFA$communalities

religiousMatrix.efa <- fa(religiousMatrix, nfactors = 1, rotate = "oblimin", fm ="ml", cor = "poly", scores = "regression")
print(religiousMatrix.efa)
fa.diagram(religiousMatrix.efa)

print(religiousMatrix.efa$loadings, cutoff = "0.3")
clean_data_summary$ReligiousFactor <- religiousMatrix.efa$scores
# data.religious$ReligiousFactor<- religious.efa$scores
```


## Combine Both Tables

```{r}
# Join the two dataframes on subj_id and user_id
final_table <- left_join(clean_data_summary, ddm_combined, by = c("user_id" = "user_id"))
```
